legend.urban.diffNote: Semi-transparent dot = likely renumbered (not a real loss or gain)
legend.urban.nightNote: Higher floors glow brighter · orange and white mix · best on a dark basemap
legend.urban.valueNote: Building + land market value (land is already included in the transaction unit price) · island-wide market total ≈ NT$204 trillion · per-building view from z13
legend.urban.propertyValueAttribution: © GlobalBuildingAtlas (TUM) · Zhu et al. 2025 · CC BY-NC 4.0 + Ministry of the Interior actual price registration
legend.urban.adminNoteTownship: Aggregated model valuations of market-traded buildings; township/district boundaries shown from z6.
legend.urban.adminNoteCounty: Aggregated model valuations of market-traded buildings; 19 of 22 counties/cities have values.
legend.urban.perCapitaHead: Total value per {scale} cell ÷ population (NT$10k per person)
legend.urban.perCapitaNote: Higher classes = more property value per resident (few people, much money); lower classes = value spread over many people. Population is an area-weighted estimate from the smallest statistical areas.
legend.urban.perCapitaExtrudedNote: 3D height is still total market value (volume); color shows per-capita value (intensity) — tall with a high-class color = few people, much money; tall with a low-class color = many people sharing it.
legend.urban.gridHead: Total value per {scale} cell (not unit price)
legend.urban.gridHeadExtruded: Total value per {scale} cell (not unit price) · 3D height synced
legend.urban.zeroCell: 0 (only non-market buildings in the cell, faded)
legend.urban.gridNote: Higher classes = more money tied up within this {scale} (volume × unit price). To see price per m², turn on the real-estate sales heatmap.
legend.urban.gridExtrudedNote: Height: ≤ {floor} sits on the ground and the highest cell island-wide ({max}) reaches full height, uncapped — extreme values spike out. Color shows distribution, height shows extremes. Contrast γ adjusts the height of mid/low values; overall height sets the full-height meters.
legend.urban.urbanFormNote: 500 m grid statistics; buildings assigned by centroid, tree canopy ≥ 3 m threshold (approximate)
legend.urban.nonUrbanNote: 18 counties/cities (Taipei City and Chiayi City are entirely under urban planning, so they have none); complements urban zoning to cover the whole island
legend.urban.jpCoverageUnavailable: Coverage catalog could not be loaded: {error}
legend.urban.jpCoverageList: The region list follows the current view and click information
legend.urban.canopyOverview: The canopy overview fills in views that have no regional detail; {resolution}, {coverage}.
legend.urban.legacyCatalog: The catalog is not installed yet; only the local Tokyo pilot is in use.
legend.urban.cappedTiles: {count} more tiles in the current view are not loaded; zoom in to see them. Missing tiles are not treated as having no buildings.
legend.urban.noTilesInView: No processed data to show at the current view or zoom.
legend.urban.partialCoverageNote: Each region is only partially covered; blank areas do not mean there are no buildings or trees.
legend.urban.jpBuildingNote: Zoomed out: median height in 10 km / 1 km / 250 m grids; z13+: individual building outlines. PLATEAU survey years differ by city; see the click popup.
legend.urban.jpCanopyNote: Meta/WRI CHMv2 2026 · model estimate · ~19.1 m projected pixel (not individual tree outlines)
legend.urban.jpCanopyDate: © Meta & WRI · CC BY 4.0 · imagery date varies by location
legend.urban.giantsHead: Distance to nearest road / trail / forest road
legend.urban.reTitleExcl: Real-estate unit price (NT$/m²) · excluding Taipei and New Taipei
legend.urban.jpGsiHillshadeNote: Grayscale terrain shading showing relief only, no values
legend.urban.jpGsiReliefNote: Colored by elevation (see the GSI explanation page for the color scale); colors indicate elevation ranges, not exact values
legend.urban.jpGsiReliefSea: Sea areas use data from the Hydrographic and Oceanographic Department, Japan Coast Guard
legend.urban.jpGsiSource: Source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI Tiles), loaded directly from the external tile server
legend.urban.gbCoverage: Coverage 4/4: England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland (Isle of Man and Channel Islands not covered)
legend.urban.gbSmallAreaSDZ21: Northern Ireland Super Data Zone (2021, switch via "NI level")
legend.urban.gbSmallAreaNiLevel: Northern Ireland Data Zones and Super Data Zones overlap; only one is shown at a time
legend.urban.gbSmallAreaNotComparable: Years and population sizes differ between the four nations, so small areas are not comparable across nations; use local authority districts for UK-wide comparison
legend.urban.gbMaritimeNationalLimit: Scotland / Wales / Northern Ireland national limit
legend.urban.gbMaritimeClosingZoom: Bay closing lines are shown from zoom 8
legend.urban.gbMaritimeCoverage: Coverage 4/4: UK waters (Overseas Territories and Crown Dependencies excluded)
legend.urban.gbMaritimeIllustrative: For illustrative purposes only; not for navigation and not prejudicial to delimitation
legend.urban.gbBuiltUpTitle: Built-up areas (OS Open Built Up Areas)
legend.urban.gbNiNotCovered: Northern Ireland: not covered (coverage 3/4: England, Scotland, Wales)
legend.urban.gbGreenspaceTitle: Parks and green space (OS Open Greenspace)
legend.urban.gbCemeteriesTitle: Cemeteries and religious grounds (OS Open Greenspace)
legend.urban.gbReligiousNote: Religious grounds are the grounds of churches and other places of worship; they often include burial grounds but are not cemeteries
legend.urban.gbGolfPoints: Golf courses (drawn as points when zoomed out to the whole UK)
legend.urban.gbHillshadeNote: Grey-scale terrain shading (light from the north-west, 45° altitude); shows relief only, no values; sea is transparent
legend.urban.gbTerrainCoverage: Coverage 3/4: England, Scotland, Wales; Northern Ireland not covered (OS Terrain 50 is Great Britain only)
legend.urban.gbTerrainResolution: OS Terrain 50: 50 m grid digital terrain model (July 2026 release), tiles at zoom 5–11
legend.urban.gbReliefStops: Colour stops (m): {stops}; colours blend continuously between stops
legend.urban.gbReliefNote: Colours are baked into the tiles upstream (lowland green → tan → brown → grey-white summits); they show elevation ranges, not exact values; sea is transparent
legend.urban.gbSurplusNotOnMarket: Surplus, not yet on the market ({n})
legend.urban.gbSurplusScope: Only surplus assets registered by central government, the NHS, the Ministry of Defence and Welsh public bodies; most English council and Scottish / Northern Irish devolved-government assets are not included
legend.urban.gbSurplusCoverage: 420 sites: England 290, Wales 115, Scotland 14, Northern Ireland 1; data as of 2026-06-29
